rows.name: TRON_BOOK_GROWTH_FACTOR

problems.statement: When a sequence outgrows its KV book (a block of KV cache memory for a run of tokens) ... token tree (the scheduler's tree of all token sequences) ... No flag exists.
problems.code_says: No code conflict. The cell defines two terms of 'Words used here', uses the word 'flag', and its first sentence does not say what the variable changes.

cells.Values and default: Decimal number, parsed with `std::stof`. Text after the number is ignored. A value below `1.0` counts as `1.0`. Text with no leading number ends the process at first use. Unset: a factor of `2.0`. Empty: `std::stof` throws, and the process ends at first use.

rows.name: TRON_DEFRAG_BOOKS_DEPTH

problems.statement: KV books (blocks of KV cache memory, one per run of tokens)
problems.code_says: A book is not one per series of tokens: a sequence that needs more room gets a further book, and the merge that this row describes puts the tokens of two tree nodes into one book. The definition is also a term of 'Words used here' and must not be repeated.

problems.statement: A negative number becomes a very large depth and ends the process during a later generation.
problems.code_says: True. std::atoi returns a negative int that converts to size_t. defrag_books() is noexcept and calls ancestry.reserve(depth), which throws std::length_error, so the process ends. The call is reached only for a node whose parent is not the root, so it is not the first token add. 'Very large' has no number and only explains the code.

cells.Values and default: Integer, parsed with `std::atoi`. It counts nodes of the token tree. `0` and text that is not a number mean off. Unset: `0`, which turns book defragmentation off.
cells.Effect: Turns on book defragmentation and sets its depth. With a value N above `0`, the scheduler tries to merge KV books before it adds tokens to a sequence. For the extended tree node and up to N-1 ancestors, a book moves into its parent's book when it fits. A negative number passes startup and ends the process during a later generation. With `TRON_DRAFT_TREE_MAX_WIDTH` above `1`, program start logs the warning `Fragmentation Risk!` when this value is below `TRON_DRAFT_TREE_MAX_DEPTH`. No command-line option sets it. No log line shows the value.
